short_description: A customer emailed complaining that the invoice PDF we sent had the wrong currency symbol in the letterhead branding — nothing to do with any automation failing
text:
A customer emailed complaining that the invoice PDF we sent had the wrong currency symbol in the letterhead branding — nothing to do with any automation failing

Root cause:
Investigation confirmed this was not an automation failure. The invoice PDF template file was updated during a recent branding refresh, and the new letterhead artwork was saved with the wrong currency symbol baked into the static header image. The RPA process was correctly pulling data and generating documents exactly as designed — it simply inherited the incorrect branding asset from the template, which was outside the automation's control.

Resolution:
Corrected the currency symbol in the invoice PDF template's letterhead artwork and had Finance/Design re-approve the corrected version. Swapped the template file referenced by the document-generation step for the corrected one — no changes were required to the automation logic itself. Flagged with the branding team that template changes should be version-checked before being pushed live, since a content-only edit like this has no automated test coverage today.

short_description: Robot repeatedly faults after each transaction, leaving queue items stuck In Progress
text:
Robot repeatedly faults after each transaction, leaving queue items stuck In Progress

Root Cause:
The robot's process was faulting due to an unhandled exception thrown during a post-processing cleanup step (closing a stale file handle) that ran after the transaction's core logic had already completed successfully, but before REFramework's SetTransactionStatus call in the End Process state. Because the fault occurred after the actual work was done but before the queue status could be recorded, each affected item was left sitting In Progress rather than being marked complete, and the robot's session ended before it could cleanly pick up the next item - repeating the same pattern on every run.

Resolution:
Wrapped the post-processing cleanup step in its own try/catch inside the End Process state so a cleanup failure no longer blocks SetTransactionStatus from running, and moved the status update to fire immediately after the core transaction logic succeeds rather than at the very end of the state. Also added a startup routine that scans for and resets any queue item left In Progress by a machine whose last heartbeat is older than 30 minutes, so a future recurrence self-heals instead of requiring manual reset.

short_description: Orchestrator folder-level permissions blocking process visibility
text:
Orchestrator folder-level permissions blocking process visibility

Root Cause:
The process lives in a modern-folder structure with folder-scoped role assignments, and the new team member's Orchestrator user account was only added to the parent folder, not the specific child folder containing this process.

Resolution:
Added the user's role assignment directly to the correct child folder, and updated the team's onboarding checklist to explicitly call out folder-level (not just tenant-level) role assignment as a required step.

short_description: Robot process consuming excessive CPU, slowing down shared VDI
text:
Robot process consuming excessive CPU, slowing down shared VDI

Root Cause:
A tight polling loop in 'StatusPoller' process was checking a status flag every 100 milliseconds instead of using a reasonable delay, pegging a CPU core continuously for the full duration of every run.

Resolution:
Added a proper Delay activity (5-second interval) inside the polling loop, and moved this specific robot off the shared VDI host onto a dedicated unattended machine given its longer-running nature.

short_description: Currency formatting mismatch causing downstream validation failure
text:
Currency formatting mismatch causing downstream validation failure

Root Cause:
The robot machine's regional settings were configured for en-US, so decimal values extracted from European-locale source documents (using comma as decimal separator) were being misparsed as thousands rather than decimals.

Resolution:
Added explicit CultureInfo handling in the numeric parsing logic based on the source document's declared locale rather than relying on the robot machine's regional settings, removing the machine-configuration dependency.

short_description: Orchestrator dashboard showing stale robot status
text:
Orchestrator dashboard showing stale robot status

Root Cause:
A transient network blip delayed a robot status heartbeat update by just over the polling interval, and Orchestrator's dashboard cache did not refresh the display in time before a scheduler dispatch decision was made.

Resolution:
Reduced the robot heartbeat interval from 60 seconds to 30 seconds to shrink the stale-status window, and enabled Orchestrator's 'reject if robot busy' server-side check so a conflicting dispatch is rejected outright instead of causing a failed job.

short_description: Attachment upload failing - file name contains special characters
text:
Attachment upload failing - file name contains special characters

Root Cause:
The target ERP system's file upload API silently rejects file names containing certain special characters (&, #, %), and the process was passing the original file name through unmodified.

Resolution:
Added a filename-sanitization step that strips or replaces unsupported special characters before upload, while preserving the original name in a metadata field for traceability.

short_description: REFramework InitAllApplications step timing out on slow VDI
text:
REFramework InitAllApplications step timing out on slow VDI

Root Cause:
That particular VDI pool was provisioned with lower baseline compute resources than the other robot pools, so application startup routinely took longer than the process's hardcoded 30-second timeout under normal (not even peak) load.

Resolution:
Increased the InitAllApplications timeout to 90 seconds and requested the VDI pool be resized to match the resource allocation of the other production robot pools.

short_description: Robot license conflict between attended and unattended sessions
text:
Robot license conflict between attended and unattended sessions

Root Cause:
The unattended job had been mistakenly scheduled against a machine template that included this shared attended/unattended workstation, and it consumed the machine's single available license slot, leaving none for the attended session the next morning.

Resolution:
Removed the shared workstation from the unattended machine template and moved unattended jobs exclusively to dedicated headless robot machines, eliminating license contention between attended users and unattended jobs.

short_description: PDF extraction activity crashing on password-protected files
text:
PDF extraction activity crashing on password-protected files

Root Cause:
The vendor started sending password-protected PDFs as a new security measure, which the Read PDF Text activity cannot open without the password, and there was no handling for this file type in the process.

Resolution:
Added a pre-check step that detects password-protected PDFs and routes them to a manual-handling queue with a clear reason code, rather than letting the activity throw an unhandled exception, and requested the vendor share the password via a secure channel for future automation.

short_description: Robot machine time drift causing scheduled job to run twice
text:
Robot machine time drift causing scheduled job to run twice

Root Cause:
The robot machine's system clock had drifted about 12 minutes out of sync because the Windows Time service had stopped after a previous update, causing its local trigger evaluation to overlap with Orchestrator's server-side trigger firing.

Resolution:
Restarted and set the Windows Time service to auto-start, pointed it at the corporate NTP server, and added a duplicate-run guard in the process itself (checks a run-lock flag) as a second layer of protection against clock-drift-caused double runs.

short_description: Dynamic web element ID changed after application update, selector break
text:
Dynamic web element ID changed after application update, selector break

Root Cause:
The finance web application's release pipeline regenerates element IDs on every deploy (auto-generated by the front-end framework's build step), so any selector anchored to a specific id attribute breaks on every single release.

Resolution:
Rebuilt selectors to anchor on stable, human-authored attributes (name and role) instead of auto-generated ids, and flagged this application to the dev team as a candidate for adding stable data-automation-id attributes for RPA use going forward.

short_description: Business exception queue growing unmonitored, SLA breach risk
text:
Business exception queue growing unmonitored, SLA breach risk

Root Cause:
The queue was correctly routing business exceptions for manual review, but no monitoring or alert was configured on the exception bucket's age or count, so it grew silently without anyone noticing until a manual audit.

Resolution:
Configured an Orchestrator alert/report to notify the process owner when business-exception items exceed a 24-hour age threshold, and added an SLA-tracking dashboard so exception backlog is visible without a manual audit.

short_description: Excel file locked - second occurrence, different shared folder
text:
Excel file locked - second occurrence, different shared folder

Root Cause:
The same antivirus scan-window overlap issue recurred - this shared folder had not yet been included in the exclusion/rescheduling fix applied after the earlier MonthEndRecon incident, since it lives on a different file server.

Resolution:
Extended the antivirus scan rescheduling and local-temp-copy pattern to this file server as well, and updated the infra runbook to apply the fix org-wide across all file servers robots read from, not per-incident.

short_description: SAP session not found - multiple SAP windows open
text:
SAP session not found - multiple SAP windows open

Root Cause:
A previous run had left an orphaned SAP GUI window open due to an earlier crash, and the process's Attach Window activity was matching on title only, sometimes attaching to the stale leftover session instead of the freshly opened one.

Resolution:
Added a pre-run cleanup step that force-closes any existing SAP GUI processes before starting, and tightened the Attach Window selector to include the session's connection ID rather than title alone.

short_description: Selector not found on internal HR portal after rebranding update
text:
Selector not found on internal HR portal after rebranding update

Root Cause:
The HR portal's rebranding release renamed several CSS classes and removed the id attributes the selectors relied on, as part of a broader front-end framework migration.

Resolution:
Rebuilt the affected selectors using more stable attributes exposed by the new framework (data-testid attributes the dev team agreed to keep stable), and set up a lightweight automated selector-health check that runs nightly and alerts before the next business day.

short_description: Robot unresponsive - Orchestrator connection lost overnight
text:
Robot unresponsive - Orchestrator connection lost overnight

Root Cause:
Same underlying cause as the prior BOT-FIN-03 incident - this machine was not yet covered by the DHCP reservation fix, since it was added to the finance robot pool after that change was rolled out.

Resolution:
Applied the same DHCP reservation and increased Orchestrator heartbeat timeout to this machine, and added a checklist item to the robot-onboarding runbook to apply network stability settings to every new machine joining a production pool.

short_description: Antivirus quarantined UiPath package executable
text:
Antivirus quarantined UiPath package executable

Root Cause:
A signature update on the endpoint antivirus flagged UiPath.Executor.exe as a false positive (generic heuristic match for 'automation/scripting tool behavior') and quarantined it automatically without notification.

Resolution:
Restored the quarantined file and added the UiPath installation directory to the antivirus's permanent exclusion list. Submitted the false positive to the antivirus vendor for signature correction.

short_description: Two-factor authentication prompt blocking unattended login
text:
Two-factor authentication prompt blocking unattended login

Root Cause:
The vendor portal rolled out a mandatory 2FA policy account-wide with no exemption path for service/automation accounts, which an unattended, headless robot session cannot complete interactively.

Resolution:
Worked with the vendor to provision a dedicated API integration account exempt from interactive 2FA, and migrated the process from UI-based login to the vendor's REST API where available, removing the UI login dependency entirely.

short_description: Orchestrator storage bucket access denied for output files
text:
Orchestrator storage bucket access denied for output files

Root Cause:
The robot's associated machine template's permissions on the storage bucket had been scoped down during a recent least-privilege security review, removing write access that the process depended on.

Resolution:
Restored write permissions on the specific storage bucket for the robot's machine template, and documented the bucket as a dependency in the process's deployment checklist so future permission reviews don't remove it unknowingly.

short_description: Two robots processing the same queue item due to race condition
text:
Two robots processing the same queue item due to race condition

Root Cause:
A custom queue-fetch implementation bypassed Orchestrator's native Get Transaction Item locking mechanism and instead queried the queue table directly, so two robot instances briefly saw and claimed the same 'New' item before either had marked it In Progress.

Resolution:
Replaced the custom queue-fetch logic with Orchestrator's native Get Transaction Item activity, which atomically locks an item to the requesting robot, eliminating the race condition entirely.

short_description: Macro security warning blocking automated Excel workbook
text:
Macro security warning blocking automated Excel workbook

Root Cause:
A security policy update changed the default macro-handling setting to 'Disable all macros with notification', which pops up a modal security banner that a headless/unattended session has no way to dismiss, blocking the workflow indefinitely.

Resolution:
Added the specific workbook's source folder to the Trusted Locations list in Excel's Trust Center settings on the robot machine, so macros load without triggering the notification banner.

short_description: Java-based application elements not detected by UI Automation
text:
Java-based application elements not detected by UI Automation

Root Cause:
The Java Access Bridge, required for UiPath's UI Automation to see individual Java Swing controls rather than just the window shell, was not enabled on the robot machine after a recent JRE upgrade reset the Java accessibility settings.

Resolution:
Re-enabled the Java Access Bridge (jabswitch -enable) and pinned the JRE version in the robot machine's image build so future JRE upgrades don't silently reset accessibility settings again.

short_description: UiPath Assistant not starting automatically on machine reboot
text:
UiPath Assistant not starting automatically on machine reboot

Root Cause:
The maintenance reboot process logged the machine out completely rather than leaving an active unattended session, and UiPath Assistant was only configured to start on user login, not on system boot without a session.

Resolution:
Reconfigured the robot machine's unattended session policy to auto-login the robot's service account on boot, and set UiPath Assistant to start via a scheduled task at system startup rather than relying solely on the Startup folder shortcut.

short_description: Robot unable to reach network share for input files
text:
Robot unable to reach network share for input files

Root Cause:
The service account's mapped network drive credentials had been reset as part of a broader password policy change, and the robot machine had not re-authenticated the persistent mapped drive, so the UNC path silently failed.

Resolution:
Updated the stored credentials for the mapped drive and switched the process to reference the UNC path directly with explicit credentials passed via the activity rather than relying on a persistent mapped drive letter, removing that failure mode entirely.

short_description: Global exception handler not catching custom exception type
text:
Global exception handler not catching custom exception type

Root Cause:
The Global Exception Handler workflow was only catching System.Exception explicitly by type in its Catch block, but the custom activity threw a custom exception class that, due to a namespace typo, wasn't actually inheriting from System.Exception as intended.

Resolution:
Fixed the custom exception class's inheritance so it properly derives from System.Exception, and broadened the Global Exception Handler's catch to the base Exception type as a safety net for any future custom exception classes.

short_description: Coordinate-based click missing target after screen resolution change
text:
Coordinate-based click missing target after screen resolution change

Root Cause:
The reimaged robot machine came up with a different default display scaling setting (125% instead of 100%), and the process relied on hardcoded screen coordinates rather than UI element selectors, so every click landed in the wrong place.

Resolution:
Rebuilt the automation using UI Automation selectors instead of hardcoded coordinates, and standardized the display scaling setting across all robot machine images to prevent this class of issue on future reimages.

short_description: Config.xlsx values mismatched between Dev and Prod after migration
text:
Config.xlsx values mismatched between Dev and Prod after migration

Root Cause:
The Production config.xlsx file was copied from the Test environment's asset folder during migration instead of being regenerated from the Production configuration template, so environment-specific values (URLs, mailboxes) were never updated.

Resolution:
Restored the correct Production values in config.xlsx and added a config-validation step at process startup that checks known environment-specific values against an expected pattern and fails fast with a clear message if they look wrong.

short_description: Queue retries exhausted - same business exception looping
text:
Queue retries exhausted - same business exception looping

Root Cause:
A business exception (missing account) is, by definition, not something a retry can fix - the queue's retry count was set to 3 by default without considering that this exception type should never be retried, only routed for manual review.

Resolution:
Reconfigured the queue-level retry policy to zero retries for exceptions explicitly tagged as BusinessRuleException, so they route straight to manual review instead of burning three automatic retry cycles first.

short_description: Orchestrator API calls failing with 401 after token expiry
text:
Orchestrator API calls failing with 401 after token expiry

Root Cause:
The integration was using a long-lived bearer token obtained once and cached indefinitely, but Orchestrator's OAuth tokens expire after 60 minutes; the script had no refresh logic for when the cached token aged out between runs.

Resolution:
Updated the PowerShell script to request a fresh token before every job trigger instead of caching it, and added a 401-triggered automatic re-authentication retry as a safety net.

short_description: Robot machine disk full, job logs failing to write
text:
Robot machine disk full, job logs failing to write

Root Cause:
Verbose-level logging had been left enabled from a previous debugging session and was never reverted, generating several GB of log files per day and filling the disk over about three weeks.

Resolution:
Reverted the process's logging level from Verbose back to Information for production, cleared the accumulated logs, and set up a scheduled cleanup task to purge log files older than 14 days on all robot machines.

short_description: Robot left in 'busy' state after orphaned process, blocking new jobs
text:
Robot left in 'busy' state after orphaned process, blocking new jobs

Root Cause:
A previous job's UiPath.Executor.exe process had become orphaned after a machine-level crash and kept holding the robot's session state as busy in Orchestrator, since the crash didn't trigger a clean session-end signal.

Resolution:
Manually killed the orphaned executor process and reset the robot's status via Orchestrator's 'Reset' action on the robot record. Enabled UiPath's watchdog / auto-recovery service on the machine to detect and clear orphaned sessions automatically going forward.

short_description: Third-party shipping API returning rate-limit errors
text:
Third-party shipping API returning rate-limit errors

Root Cause:
A parallel batch of manual lookups by the logistics team, run through the same shared API key, pushed combined call volume over the carrier's per-minute rate limit during business hours.

Resolution:
Added exponential backoff and retry logic around the HTTP Request activity for 429 responses, and requested a dedicated API key with a higher rate limit for the robot's traffic, separate from manual/human usage.

short_description: Windows update broke file path automation after path change
text:
Windows update broke file path automation after path change

Root Cause:
The Windows update changed the default redirected Documents folder path structure under a OneDrive-for-Business sync policy that was newly enforced, so the hardcoded local path the process referenced no longer existed.

Resolution:
Replaced the hardcoded path with a Get Environment Variable-based path resolution and moved the archive target to a UNC network share instead of a local user profile folder, removing the dependency on machine-specific path structures entirely.

short_description: Robot machine screen locked, unattended job could not run
text:
Robot machine screen locked, unattended job could not run

Root Cause:
A group policy update pushed by IT security re-enabled the screen lock / inactivity timeout on RPA-11, overriding the unattended robot's exemption that had been set months earlier, likely due to a GPO refresh cycle.

Resolution:
Re-applied the screen-lock exemption group policy for the robot machine's OU and added it to a dedicated 'Unattended Robots' GPO block that IT security excludes from the general inactivity-lock rollout, with a documented exception record.

short_description: Data scraping breaking due to website table structure change
text:
Data scraping breaking due to website table structure change

Root Cause:
The target website migrated its pricing table from a static HTML <table> to a JavaScript-rendered grid component, so the previous Extract Structured Data activity's static-page assumptions no longer matched the live DOM.

Resolution:
Replaced the static table extraction with a Data Scraping wizard re-run against the new dynamic grid, and added an explicit page-load wait tied to a specific grid-loaded UI element rather than a fixed delay.

short_description: Citrix image-based selector failing after screen resolution change
text:
Citrix image-based selector failing after screen resolution change

Root Cause:
IT pushed a display resolution change on the Citrix virtual desktop template (from 1920x1080 to 1600x900) as part of a broader VDI refresh, which shifted every on-screen coordinate the image-based automation depended on.

Resolution:
Rebuilt the Citrix automation using Citrix's native UI Automation extension where element-level selectors are available, and reserved a fixed-resolution Citrix policy specifically for the robot's published desktop so future VDI-wide changes don't affect it.

short_description: UiPath Robot service crashing due to high memory usage
text:
UiPath Robot service crashing due to high memory usage

Root Cause:
A long-running loop in process 'BulkDataExport' was opening a new Excel Application Scope on every iteration without properly closing the previous instance, leaking Excel processes and memory over a multi-thousand-row run.

Resolution:
Refactored the loop to reuse a single Excel Application Scope for the entire run instead of opening/closing per iteration, and added an explicit Kill Process cleanup step in the Global Exception Handler as a safety net.

short_description: SQL query timeout in database lookup activity
text:
SQL query timeout in database lookup activity

Root Cause:
The underlying payroll table had grown significantly and was missing an index on the employee_id column used in the WHERE clause, causing a full table scan under peak monthly load.

Resolution:
Worked with the DBA team to add an index on employee_id, and increased the activity's CommandTimeout property from the 30s default to 120s as a safety margin for future load growth.

short_description: VPN dropped mid-run leaving partial data entered in legacy system
text:
VPN dropped mid-run leaving partial data entered in legacy system

Root Cause:
The corporate VPN tunnel to the legacy system's data center dropped for about 90 seconds during a routine failover on the VPN concentrator, interrupting the robot's session mid-transaction with no transactional rollback in the legacy CRM itself.

Resolution:
Added a pre-save validation checkpoint and a compensating 'undo partial update' sub-routine triggered on connection-loss exceptions, so a dropped session rolls the record back to its prior state instead of leaving it half-updated. Also added a Retry Scope with a connectivity check before resuming.

short_description: New package version broke process in Production after publish
text:
New package version broke process in Production after publish

Root Cause:
The Production Orchestrator environment was still pointing robots at the 'Latest Available' package version policy, so a newer, unvalidated package version auto-deployed to Production robots as soon as it was published to the feed, bypassing the intended Test-then-Prod promotion gate.

Resolution:
Rolled the Production process back to the last known-good package version. Changed the Production environment's deployment policy from 'Latest Available' to a specific pinned version, requiring an explicit promotion step after Test sign-off.

short_description: Scheduled job did not trigger at expected time
text:
Scheduled job did not trigger at expected time

Root Cause:
The Orchestrator trigger was configured using the server's local time zone, but the intended run time was based on the business's regional time zone, which is 3 hours 40 minutes offset - the two had drifted apart after a recent Orchestrator server migration to a UTC-hosted VM.

Resolution:
Reconfigured the trigger's time zone setting explicitly to the business region instead of inheriting server-local time, and added a naming convention note in the trigger description to always state which time zone was intended.

short_description: Outlook COM error - 'Cannot start Microsoft Outlook'
text:
Outlook COM error - 'Cannot start Microsoft Outlook'

Root Cause:
A Windows update on RPA-04 had reset Outlook's default profile configuration, and Outlook was prompting a first-run setup wizard that blocks headless/unattended automation from initializing the COM object.

Resolution:
Re-configured the Outlook profile manually and disabled the first-run wizard via registry key (DisableFirstRunCustomize). Migrated the process to use the Microsoft Graph API mail activities instead of Outlook COM to remove the dependency on a locally installed, logged-in Outlook client.

short_description: OCR extraction returning garbled text from scanned invoices
text:
OCR extraction returning garbled text from scanned invoices

Root Cause:
Meridian Supplies switched to a new scanner that outputs at 150 DPI instead of the previous 300 DPI, and the scans are slightly skewed, which drops OCR confidence below the extractor's threshold on numeric fields.

Resolution:
Added a deskew + upscale preprocessing step before OCR for this vendor's document type, and lowered the confidence threshold slightly for this template with a human-validation fallback queue for anything under 85% confidence.

short_description: REFramework misclassifying business exceptions as system exceptions
text:
REFramework misclassifying business exceptions as system exceptions

Root Cause:
The custom validation logic in Process.xaml was throwing a generic System.Exception instead of the intended BusinessRuleException type, so REFramework's catch block in the transaction-level try/catch routed it down the system-exception (retry) path.

Resolution:
Changed the validation throw to use New BusinessRuleException("Invalid vendor ID") so it's caught correctly and logged as a single business exception with no retries. Added a unit-level check in the CI pipeline that flags any raw System.Exception usage in Process.xaml going forward.

short_description: Orchestrator asset credential rejected - invalid password
text:
Orchestrator asset credential rejected - invalid password

Root Cause:
The service account's Active Directory password had auto-rotated on its 90-day policy cycle; the corresponding Orchestrator asset was never updated with the new password since it's not part of the AD rotation automation.

Resolution:
Updated the Orchestrator credential asset with the new password. Added the service account to the exception list for the AP team's password-rotation notification distro, and logged a follow-up to move this asset to a Credential Vault integration so rotation is automatic.

short_description: Robot unable to check out license - 'no available runtime license'
text:
Robot unable to check out license - 'no available runtime license'

Root Cause:
A separate test robot that had crashed mid-session was still holding a runtime license checked out from the on-prem license server; the license had not been released because the machine was powered off ungracefully.

Resolution:
Released the orphaned license from the UiPath License Management Console. Enabled the license server's auto-release-on-timeout setting (license reclaimed after 4 hours of no heartbeat) to avoid manual intervention next time.

short_description: Queue item stuck In Progress after robot crash
text:
Queue item stuck In Progress after robot crash

Root Cause:
The robot process crashed (unhandled COM exception in an Excel interop call) without going through REFramework's Kill/Cleanup state, so it never called SetTransactionStatus to release the queue items back to Orchestrator.

Resolution:
Manually reset the three stuck items to New via Orchestrator so they were re-picked-up. Added a try/finally-style Global Exception Handler wrapper around the Excel interop block and set the queue's automatic 'stale item' reset policy to 60 minutes to prevent recurrence.

short_description: Excel file locked, workbook activities failing intermittently
text:
Excel file locked, workbook activities failing intermittently

Root Cause:
A scheduled antivirus scan was opening and holding a lock on the shared network folder's .xlsx files at the same time the robot's job window ran, colliding with the robot's own file access.

Resolution:
Rescheduled the antivirus scan window to avoid overlap with the robot's run time, and switched the workbook activities from the classic Excel scope to a file-copy-then-process pattern so the robot always works on a local temp copy.

short_description: Selector not found on SAP GUI transaction screen
text:
Selector not found on SAP GUI transaction screen

Root Cause:
SAP GUI Scripting was disabled on the robot machine after a routine SAP client patch reset the local client options (Scripting tab, 'Enable Scripting' checkbox reverted to unchecked).

Resolution:
Re-enabled SAP GUI Scripting in SAP Logon Options and added it to server-side SAP profile parameters (sapgui/user_scripting = TRUE) so it survives future client patches. Documented the check as a pre-flight step in the process's dispatcher.

short_description: Selector not found on customer web portal after login step
text:
Selector not found on customer web portal after login step

Root Cause:
The web portal's front-end team pushed a UI update that changed the Accounts tab's underlying DOM structure (a wrapping <div> was added), which broke the fuzzy selector's idx and class-based attributes.

Resolution:
Rebuilt the selector using a more resilient attribute (aria-label instead of class), added a WaitForReady=INTERACTIVE + explicit Element Exists check before the click, and dropped in a 3-retry Retry Scope around the navigation block.

short_description: Unattended robot lost connection to Orchestrator mid-transaction
text:
Unattended robot lost connection to Orchestrator mid-transaction

Root Cause:
The robot machine's network adapter renewed its DHCP lease during the scheduled job window, briefly dropping connectivity for ~40 seconds. UiPath Robot service did not reconnect to Orchestrator automatically within the default heartbeat timeout, so Orchestrator marked the robot Disconnected and orphaned the in-progress queue items.

Resolution:
Set a static IP / DHCP reservation for BOT-FIN-03 to avoid mid-shift lease renewal. Increased Orchestrator's robot heartbeat timeout from 30s to 90s. Manually reset the orphaned queue items from In Progress back to New so they were picked up on the next run.
